test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spill the beans
solution: The correct answer is **Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"spill the beans"** means to reveal a secret or disclose information that was meant to be kept confidential. (राज़ खोलना) • **Example: **John couldn't keep it to himself any longer and** spilled the beans **about the surprise party. • **"To leak a secret"** implies divulging confidential information to someone who is not supposed to know it. (गुप्त जानकारी लीक करना) • **Example: **She accidentally **leaked the secret **of the new project to the competitor. Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 2.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Cook the beans carefully** (बीन्स को सावधानी से पकाना): This option is literal and does not relate to the idiom. • **Example: **Make sure to **cook the beans carefully** to avoid them getting burnt. • **To help someone extraordinarily** (किसी की असाधारण रूप से मदद करना): This option is unrelated to the idiom's meaning. • **Example: **She went out of her way **to help someone extraordinarily **during the crisis. • **The act of loving beans** (बीन्स से प्यार करने का कार्य): This option is completely irrelevant to the idiom's meaning. • **Example: **His **act of loving beans** was evident in his daily diet. 59:Tbc6, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
